integrity: All proof claims are specified in RESULT.md, independently reconstructible from exact eigenvalue identities and the included standard-library checker; no independent mathematical audit has been carried out.
scientific_limitations: Finite numerical checks supplement an exact Fourier/linear-dual proof and cannot prove all-dimensional statements by themselves. Unrestricted optimal matrices need not be unique; only their mandatory omission of distance-one edges for dimensions at least seven is proved. The full text of Karlin–Lindqvist–Yao (1993), a plausible general hypercube-spectra reference, was not accessible for a decisive priority comparison.
title: Sharp dimension-seven deletion of nearest-neighbor edges in fastest-mixing binary walks
